notes.title: [𝐍𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐞] 𝐄𝐧𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐨𝐫 𝐒𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝟏
notes.content:
Greetings, Valiant Saviors!
This is GM Triple with exciting news!
The limited-time event content, [Endless Corridor], will be revealed shortly.
Please find detailed information and schedule below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/5f1ccfcd51e52001af741a1cc0cd188f1df7dc11.png[/img]

◆ 𝐄𝐧𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐨𝐫 𝐒𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝟏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/f7c3d0f5aeeea6e4e9c05b6c6fe9fc9c8e735176.png[/img]

▶ Event Period: February 19th After Update (UTC) ~ March 7th 00:00 (UTC)
▶ Endless Corridor Ranking Rewards Distribution Time : March 7th 00:00 (UTC)
※ Ranking rewards will be distributed via in-game mail.
▶ Event Details
- You can enter the event page through the Endless Corridor icon of the main screen or the event icon on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/bf6291708ed26ca6201bf5757e9c308210ce6036.png[/img]
- Endless Corridor can be played freely without entry restrictions.
- You can compose your deck by selecting cards and support cards chosen for each season.
- If you don't possess the selected cards, you can use Level 20 cards in [Endless Corridor].
- The selected cards are copied one by one at the start of battle and added to your deck.
- In addition to the selected cards, you can add two Epic Cards and two Legend Cards as assistants.
- Wild Cards cannot be used as assistants, and if they are selected cards, they will change to the least common job/attribute in the deck.
- You can receive additional buffs based on the total level of the cards in your deck.
- Rewards are given for each breakthrough in the Endless Corridor, and additional rewards are provided based on your ranking.

* Season 1 Selected Card
: Machinist Curtis, Chainsaw Girl Roxy, Punk Shooter Alice, Canon Shooter Ayla, Magic Scholar Faye, Wind-up Mage Glenn, Demolition Expert Jhin, Gunslinger Jerry, Occultist Luke

* Season 1 Unusable Cards
: Yasmasa, Sherlock, Arsene, Agatha, Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Scrime, Brion, Babariba, Lucius

* Please check in-game information for Endless Corridor ranking rewards and rewards based on the covered distance.
※ For rewards based on the covered distance, rewards from 1 to 49km will repeat from 51km onwards.

If you have any inquiries regarding the event, please contact us in the game via Setting > 1:1 Inquiry with details of the problem and we will try to help you at our best.
Thank you.

notes.content:
Greetings, Valiant Saviors!
This is GM Triple with the latest updates about our game!
Here are the details for the 7.53.0 update scheduled to go live on February 19, 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/1d90a4508139697166b804363a110deb90c4b713.png[/img]

◆ 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 ‘𝐁𝐨𝐦𝐛 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐚’
- A new Fire Devil, [Bomb Mania], will be unveiled. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/93b2f005c83f3abf12e1e775f1d1362dfb61acc3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/7f021349087c06ba1be41a032f880e77a3945e30.png[/img]

𝟏. 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐂𝐲𝐜𝐥𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞
- The Devil rotation cycle has been changed from the previous 1 month to 2 weeks, and [Bomb Mania] will be added to the rotation.
※ The new Devil [Bomb Mania] content will be available for challenge after the update on the 19th.

𝟐. 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐂𝐥𝐢𝐦𝐛𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐑𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐬
- A new rule has been added that requires defeating the previously summoned Devil to be able to summon the next level Devil.
 : After the update, all Valiant Saviors can progress in climbing from Level 1 Devil, and you can obtain initial rewards and achievement rewards for each Devil level.

𝟑. 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐄𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥
- Rewards that can be obtained will be added for unlocking each Devil level.

𝟒. 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥 𝐔𝐧𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐤 𝐀𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
- [Devil Conquest] achievement is added.
 : Unlock Devil at a certain level
* Achievement Reward: Soul Stone

◆ 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝟐 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬
- Guild Battle Season 2 will be underway.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/bde2626c14fb1fff44d7a36cbd6b53505d0f9d2e.png[/img]

▶ 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐝 : February 19th (Mon) ~ May 12th (Sun)

[𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝟐 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐬]
* Guild Battle sign-up period has been changed to Monday 00:00 ~ Thursday 00:00 (UTC).
* The Guild Battle combat time, previously divided into 3, will be unified and held from Friday 00:00 ~ Sunday 01:00 (UTC).
* The initially given Stamina will increase by 10, and Stamina will be recharged every 20 minutes.
* The map size will increase, and the difficulty will be adjusted according to the map size.
* The quantity of artifacts appearing on the map will increase significantly, and the individual abilities of artifacts will decrease.
* A new artifact, [Mana Stone], will be added. (Initial Trick of Guild Members +1)
* The Initial Trick of the Guild Battle will be changed to 1/3 of the Max Trick.
* The Boss that appears periodically will now appear every 6 hours and be announced 30 minutes before its appearance.

◆ 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐑𝐞𝐯𝐚𝐦𝐩

[𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩]
- Two new Memberships will be added.

𝟏. 𝐄𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐲 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩
: Immediate Rewards: Energy 750, Instant Completion Ticket 25
: Daily Rewards: Energy 250, Instant Completion Chance 10
※ The Instant Completion Chance 10 times per day for daily rewards does not accumulate and resets daily if unused.

𝟐. 𝐒𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐨𝐧 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩
: Immediate Rewards: Premium Card Summon Ticket 30
: Daily Rewards: Premium Card Summon Chance 10
※ The Premium Card Summon Chance 10 times per day for daily rewards does not accumulate and resets daily if unused.

[𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐤𝐬]
- New Membership Perks, [Triple Membership] and [Max Membership], will be added.

𝟏. 𝐓𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐤
: Additional benefits for those who join three or more Memberships.
- Ruby reward amount from the mine +50%
- Sapphire reward amount from the mine +50%
- Emerald reward amount from the mine +50%
- Magic Gem reward amount from the mine +50%

𝟐. 𝐌𝐚𝐱 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐤
: Additional benefits for those who join four or more Memberships.
- Daily free attempts +1 for Premium Summon
- Daily free attempts +1 for Mythic Summon
- Daily free attempts +1 for Equipment Summon
- Daily free attempts +1 for Rune Summon.

[𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐌𝐚𝐱 𝐌𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤]
- A Max Membership Pack, allowing the purchase of all Membership products at a lower price, will be added. This pack can be purchased repeatedly without any limit.
- Product Effects: Apply perks from five Memberships (Login, Gold, Diamond, Energy, Summon Membership)
- Purchase Limit: None

※ With the addition of the Max Membership Pack, the sale of the Triple Membership product will end on February 19th (Mon) at 00:00.
※ Triple Membership purchased before the sales end will retain its perks even after the sales conclude.

◆ 𝐀𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐬
- [Card Collector] Achievement 23 types will be added, and some achievement rewards will be changed.
: With the added achievements, the conditions for acquiring Card Collector and Card Collector King will change.
- Rewards for the [Purple Star Collector] achievement will change.

◆ 𝐎𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬
- After update, [Johan], [Elizabeth], and [ATF Operation Officer] will appear in the Premium Summon.
- A UI has been added to the Devil Battle entrance screen where you can see the quantity of Ranking Rewards that can be obtained per day.
- A Timer UI has been added to the Devil Summon screen to show when the Devil will be replaced.
- "Bomb Mania" has been added to the Devil group collection.
- A popup will be added to notify that additional Soul Stones cannot be obtained upon clearing the Outpost if the Soul Stone is already full when entering.
- [Overcharge Counter] will be added to the Diamond Shop.
: The Counter increases every time a Diamond product is purchased, and when the Counter is full, there will be a chance to receive bonus Diamonds with purchases.
: The Diamond product Overcharge Counter charges based on the total number of Diamonds, including bonuses.
※ The Counter gauge will be reset to 0 with the update on the 19th.
※ The Diamond Counter will not apply to the quantity of Diamonds purchased before the update on the 19th. It will only apply to the quantity of Diamonds purchased after the update on the 19th.
- The issue of returning to the default deck after clearing the Normal Dungeon in Abyssal Rift has been fixed.
- [Convenience Update] The [Card Illustration On/Off during Battle] feature has been added to the settings.
- [Convenience Update] Friend Requests, previously stored in the mailbox, will now be visible in the Friend Tab.
- [Convenience Update] An Equipment Index has been added.
: The Equipment Index can be viewed in the [Equipment Menu] and [Equipment Summon Screen].
: In the Equipment Index, you can compare the selected Equipment with My Best Equipment by pressing the [Compare] button.
- [Convenience Update] A search function has been added to the Rune Index.
If you need assistance with the update or have any related questions, please leave detailed information through the in-game settings > 1:1 inquiry, and we will do our best to assist you.
Thank you.

notes.content:
Greetings, Valiant Saviors!
This is GM Triple with the latest updates about our game!
Here are the details for the 7.52.0 update scheduled to go live on January 25, 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/f4030d7fcd2eaa1ecee3969625e46d8e75651ded.png[/img]

◆ 𝐓𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐬𝐲 𝟓𝐭𝐡 𝐀𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐚𝐫𝐲 𝐀𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭
- Join the special Attendance Check Event starting on January 30th (Tue) to commemorate Triple Fantasy's 5th anniversary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/bed779dc6c26a997d24d6713f21dc19577c4cdc9.png[/img]

◆ 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐆𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐮𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐑𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬
[Addition of Limit Break Guarantee]
- Limit Break Skill Guarantee Counter function is added, allowing you to definitively acquire the desired Limit Break Skill.
* When rotating skills, you can earn scores based on the grade of the skill that appears. When the score reaches 9,000, the specified skill is definitively guaranteed to appear in the next rotation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/82365150a696e9897b6b55cde11886931a745da9.png[/img]

[Addition of Favorited Limit Break Skill and Continuous Transcendence Features]
- A function is added to quickly acquire Favorited Limit Break Skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/d1332e9d845c1356fc6d0795032de489de22d55a.png[/img]

1. Favorited Limit Break Skill Function
- You can register up to three skills as Favorited Limit Break Skills to receive notifications when they appear.
: Confirmation/Favorited Skill appearance is highlighted with effects.
: Guidance is provided when attempting to change Confirmation/Favorited Skill after appearance.
2. Continuous Limit Break Rotation Function
- The Continuous Limit Break Rotation function can be used after registering one or more Favorited Skills.
- Continuously rotates until the registered Confirmation/Favorited Skill appears.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/e31f72e74620a120ac59d767da68b0feaaf9decf.png[/img]
※ Retroactive application does not apply to feature updates.

◆ 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐑𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐬
- The Limit Break Skill Rotation rules have been changed for more convenience, and the UI has been updated.
* Before Change: Release Limit Break, remove existing Limit Break Skill, implement Limit Break again, and choose a new Limit Break Skill.
* After Change: Keep the existing Limit Break Skill, choose a new Limit Break Skill.
※ With the change in Limit Break Skill Rotation rules, the previously required Diamond cost (25 Diamond) for releasing Limit Break Skills is no longer needed.

◆ 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐦𝐞 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐋𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐒𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞
- A feature is added to choose the look before and after Limit Break for costumes.
: Go to Manage Deck > Select Card > Costume to set it up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/352ca5dbd97f89b666ae51ab8eb0b5c9ed2493a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/bf9e9a08471270c04296a962eca974e354b93fec.png[/img]

◆ 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐄𝐗𝐏 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐔𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐈𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐬
- When using Limit Break Wings and Super Evolution Stones, the EXP and Evolution Materials invested in the card will be refunded.
: When using Limit Break Wings, EXP and Evolution Materials used before reaching level 99 will be refunded.
: When using Super Evolution Stones, all used enhancement materials will be refunded.
※ Retroactive application does not apply to feature updates.

◆ 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐑𝐮𝐧𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐆𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫
- Legend Guarantee Counter is added to Rune Summon.
: After a maximum of 75 summons, you will definitively obtain a Legend Rune.
※ The counter increases each time a non-legendary rune is summoned, and it resets when a Legend Rune is obtained.

◆ 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐄𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐒𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐨𝐧 + 𝐆𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫
- Legend + Guarantee Counter is added to Equipment Summon.
: After a maximum of 150 summons, you will definitively obtain Legend Equipment.
: After a maximum of 150 summons, there is a 10% chance to definitively obtain Celestial Equipment instead of Legend Equipment.
※ The counter increases each time equipment below the legendary grade is summoned, and it resets when Legend or Celestial Equipment is obtained.

◆ 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐌𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐜 𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐄𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
- The maximum grade of equipment is expanded from Celestial to Mythic.
: Synthesize three Celestial Equipment to obtain one Mythic Equipment.
: The probability of Celestial Equipment appearing in Equipment Summon is added, and accordingly, the summon probability by grade in Equipment Summon is changed.
Please refer to the table below.
* Probability of summoning Celestial grade Equipment: 0.05%, newly added
* Probability of summoning Basic grade Equipment: Previous 66.00% > Changed 65.95% (Change compared to the previous -0.05%)

◆ 𝐀𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐥𝐥𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝟏𝐬𝐭 𝐄𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐒𝐞𝐭
- Illustrations for Lilith, Iris, and Drago cards are added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/5ed810958142fb9c35b56ab20db45f2094188c20.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/f44e29bd507147a0419b818b169f75ca9b0581bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/0601819ca35ad1383fbc3f35d3d14d57aea4123a.png[/img]

◆ 𝐎𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬
- [Yellow Dragon] and [Nine-Tailed Miho] cards are added to the card collection.
- Selective Summon is now available for only 7 days from the initial acquisition.
: Even for existing users with Selective Summon, a 7-day time limit will be applied after the January 25th update.
: If you do not perform any summons after acquiring Selective Summon, you cannot receive summon rewards.
: If you do not claim the last summon result by the expiration date without collecting it after performing Selective Summon, it will be provided as a reward.
- A confirmation popup will appear before performing Extract All Essence.
- Grades such as 'All Grade' and 'Mythic Grade' are removed from the menu of Extract All Essence, and Normal Grade is shown as the default.
- [Convenience Update] A rank menu is added to view the rankings of other guilds on the guild screen.
- [Convenience Update] During Equipment Enhancement, a popup menu is added to check the increased value of equipment and adjust the enhancement stage.

notes.title: [Update] 7.42.0 Update Notice (Guild Battle Pre-season Update)
notes.content:
Greetings, Valiant Saviors!
This is GM Triple bringing you the latest news.
We would like to announce that the Guild Battle Pre-season will be updated by August 24.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/5e466195c6dec9a50f39116ccdcd11178248a74a.png[/img]

◆ Guild Battle Pre-season
- Seek the Mightiest Guild!! Guild Battle Pre-season is about to begin.
▶ Pre-season Period : August 21st 00:00 ~ September 18th 00:00 (UTC)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/a28ee03b2591d08106fc06d624bda36f442fad49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/41729bc3212d48ee951b8109b8788d67e718c31f.png[/img]

[Guild Battle Rules]
- The Guild that occupies more areas from the starting point wins.
- You can enter areas adjacent to the occupied ones and consume stamina.
- You cannot enter areas disconnected from the starting point.
- Certain areas hold hidden treasures that strengthen all Guild members.
- Every 10 minutes, a boss appears in a random area. The adjacent 6 tiles from the point of appearance become neutralized.
- Defeating the boss grants special treasures.
- The Guild Battle lasts for 40 minutes.

[Guild Battle Combat Rules]
- All learned Guild Skills are applied.
- You commence battles with half the Max Trick count.
- Team bonuses are not applied, and cards below level 99 are adjusted to level 99 stats.

[Guild Battle Matching]
- Guild Master or Guild Submaster can choose a time slot for the Guild Battle during the Guild Battle Sign-up period. Guild Master or Guild Submaster can select a time slot for the Guild Battle during the Guild Battle sign-up period.
1. Guild Battle Sign-up Period
: Monday 00:00 ~ Friday 00:00 (UTC)
2. Guild Battle Period
: Saturday 13:00 ~ Sunday 05:00
3. Guild Battle Time
- Saturday: 13:00
- Saturday: 21:00
- Sunday: 05:00

[Rewards and Contribution]
- Different Guild Fund Rewards are provided for Victory, Draw, and Defeat.
- Individual Contribution Rewards are granted based on personal actions.
1. Guild Fund Reward
- Victory : 2000
- Draw : 1000
- Defeat : 600
* Guild Fund Rewards can be obtained at a rate of 100% when the combined contribution of Guild members are 500 or more. (If the total contribution is less than 500, the rewards are obtained in proportion to [total contribution / 500.]
* In case of a walkover win, Guild Fund 1000 will be granted.
2. Guild Battle Contribution Reward
- Stamina Usage : 2
- Area Occupation : 1
- Treasure Acquisition : 9
- Battle Start : 1
- Battle Victory : 5
3. Individual Rewards based on Contribution
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42276638/403ac835d857c71fa3febe932f8fc3feda4bb7fb.jpg[/img]

4. MVP Reward
- At the end of Guild Battle, your best record will be displayed in the Battle Record and you will receive rewards.
- 3 Guild members at maximum will be selected as MVP, including King of King.
* MVP Selection Rules
1. The participant with the highest contribution among attendees is selected as the MVP.
2. The remaining two participants, excluding the first person, are randomly chosen.
3. The second participant chooses one of the available MVPs and is awarded the MVP (except for King of Kings).
4. If the third person has no MVPs, the selection is repeated from the remaining participants until all three are chosen.
(MVP Types and Rules)
- King of Kings : Most Contribution within the guild
- King of Occupation : Most areas occupied
- King of Battle : Most battles participated
- King of Victory : Most victories in battles
- King of Winning Streak : Most consecutive victories in battles (3 or more)
- King of Attack : Most victories in attack battles
- King of Defense : Most victories in defense battles
- King of Action : Most Stamina used
- King of Treasure : Most treasures discovered
(Rewards for Each MVP)
- King of King : 10 Diamonds, 300 Guild Points
- Other MVPs : 10 Diamonds, 100 Guild Points

※ Note
- If you lose a battle, you cannot take actions for 1 minute as a penalty.
- You can attempt a normal battle by selecting a tile that is not under attack by the opponent.
- Placed monsters are arranged into 1-stage dungeons and appear on the map.
- Winning a PvE battle leads to area occupation.
- While the opponent attacks a tile or conducts a normal battle, you can initiate a battle by attempting an attack.
- Placed monsters appear on both sides of the field and engage in PvP battles.
- The side that wins in PvP will occupy the tile.

◆ Other Changes
- The issue of Sun Wukong's clone being removed by the Truth Mirror skill will be addressed.
- Battle Speed Control button will be changed to an On / Off format.
Should you have any inquiries regarding the Guild Battle Pre-season, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us through the in-game 1:1 inquiry system.
Thank you.
